To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the efficiency of a parallel Branch-and-bound algorithm is influenced by the initialization method and that the efficiency of the overall Branch-and-bound algorithm can be improved by a suitable choice of the initialization method.

the efficiency of the initialization methods depends on the structure of the search tree and that the fourth method, which is the only method that does not require a global OPEN set, is the best choice for a parallel implementation of Branch-and-bound algorithms.

the best initialization method for a centralized OPEN set in a parallel Branch-and-bound algorithm is the one that selects the node with the largest lower bound, that this is also the most efficient initialization method for a parallel Branch-and-Bound algorithm with a distributed OPEN set, and that the efficiency of the other methods depends on the number of parallel processors and the branching factor of a search tree.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: What is the best way of distributing the OPEN set of a parallel Branch-and-Bound Algorithm?
the design of a parallel Branch-and-bound algorithm that can efficiently be initialized by a parallel algorithm and that can be executed efficiently on a parallel computer.
the question of how to initialize a parallel Branch-and-bound algorithm efficiently.

the initialization method of the parallel Branch-and-bound algorithm is of minor importance.
the initialization of a parallel Branch-and-bound algorithm should not be done by an exhaustive enumeration of the initial search tree.
the fourth initialization method is the most promising one.
